description: This file is a shell script that defines and runs a suite of Git-related tests focusing on the behavior of 'git diff-tree' with the '--max-depth' option, directory and index traversal, and edge cases involving pathspecs and subtrees.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and writes a specified file within it.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates a file and nested directories to set up test scenarios.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Performs a diff-tree check with specified parameters and compares the output with expected results.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Checks directory trees at various max-depth levels, testing tree traversal behavior.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks index traversal with various max-depth levels.
